description.zh: 应用ID，通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The application ID, which is created and queried via the console. Only a single ID is supported.

description.zh: 已存在的频道ID，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: An existing channel ID. Only a single ID is supported.

description.zh: 已存在的旁路推流的任务ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大55字节。不填，则由系统自动生成。
description.en: The ID of an existing bypass stream ingest job. Only a single ID is supported. It can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens (-), with a maximum length of 55 bytes. If not specified, the system will automatically generate one.

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于停止在线频道旁路推流任务。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
This API is used to stop a bypass stream ingest job for an online channel.  
### queries per second (QPS) Limit  
The QPS limit for this API is 10 queries per second (QPS) per user. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to rate limiting, which may impact your business. Invoke this API appropriately.
